info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchant Deactivation API
info.description: This API allows users to deactivate a merchant account within the system. By sending a DELETE request to the endpoint, users can remove a specific merchant, identified by their merchant ID. This operation is crucial for businesses aiming to manage their merchant roster, ensuring that outdated or inactive accounts are promptly addressed. Typical consumers of this API include administrative users and finance teams looking to streamline merchant management processes.

delete.summary: Remove a merchant from the system.
delete.description: This operation allows you to permanently delete a merchant identified by their unique ID (MER-800045). Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action, as it cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete the merchant identified by MER-800045. Ensure that you provide all necessary details to successfully process the delete operation.

204.description: The resource was successfully deleted with no content returned.

DeleteMerchantByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a merchant operation. It is a string value that may contain any relevant information required for the operation.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication scheme, which utilizes a JSON Web Token (JWT) as a means of representing claims that can be transmitted between two parties. Clients must include the JWT in the Authorization header of their requests to authenticate.
